channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: EU says it will accept no increase in US tariffs after Supreme Court ruling: 'a deal is a deal'
item.description: The European Commission demanded on Sunday that the United States stick to the terms of an EU-U.S. trade deal reached last year, after the U.S. Supreme Court struck down Donald Trump's global tariffs and he responded with new levies across the board.

item.title: 6 bodies recovered after passenger boat sinks in northern Vietnam
item.description: Rescue teams recovered all six bodies of victims on Sunday afternoon following a passenger boat sinking on Thac Ba Lake in Lao Cai Province, northern Vietnam.

item.title: Vietnam Lunar New Year traffic accidents fall 29%, deaths down 23%
item.description: Traffic accidents across Vietnam during the nine-day 2026 Lunar New Year holiday from February 14 to Sunday fell sharply from a year earlier, with 381 crashes nationwide killing 230 people and injuring 274, the Traffic Police Department said.

item.title: Vietnam issues new decree outlining deportation rules for foreign violators
item.description: Vietnam’s government has issued a decree setting out rules for deporting foreigners who violate Vietnamese law, as well as procedures for administrative detention and escort of offenders.

item.title: Vietnam supplies nearly half of US woodwork imports in 11 months of 2025
item.description: The United States spent nearly US$18 billion importing wooden furniture between January and November last year, with Vietnamese products accounting for almost half of that total.

item.title: Nearly 2.6 million students return to school after Tet in Ho Chi Minh City
item.description: Nearly 2.6 million students across Ho Chi Minh City streamed back to school on Monday following a Lunar New Year holiday (Tet) lasting more than 10 days.

item.title: Highways congested as millions return to Ho Chi Minh City after Tet holiday
item.description: Millions of people traveling back to Ho Chi Minh City from the Mekong Delta on Sunday, the final day of the 2026 Lunar New Year (Tet) holiday, caused severe congestion on several highways and intersections, especially in Dong Thap Province.

item.title: Drone incursions disrupt dozens of flights at Da Nang airport during Tet
item.description: Da Nang International Airport in central Vietnam reported three incidents of unauthorized drones entering its airspace during the recent Lunar New Year (Tet) holiday, forcing 49 flights to delay take-offs and landings, authorities said on Sunday.

item.title: Milan-Cortina hailed as 'new kind' of Winter Olympics at closing ceremony
item.description: International Olympic Committee president Kirsty Coventry lauded Milan-Cortina 2026 as a "new kind of Winter Games" as she declared them closed on Sunday.

item.title: Top Mexican drug cartel leader killed
item.description: The Mexican army announced Sunday that it had killed powerful drug lord Nemesio "El Mencho" Oseguera in an operation that sparked a wave of violence in various parts of the country.
